_doc: profile_sketch.py displacement fields (world metres): top = dz over y bump for z above z ramp; bow = squash of z above base by scale at the bump; rear = behind y[0]..y[1] the loop end moves top/bottom (split at mid); uarch = dz over y bump for z below z ramp; tips = dz ramping in over y for z below z; upper_aft = dy for the arms/bridge/upper wings, growing with z over the z ramp (full at the junction, fading down the front arms), from y_from
